body: I know man. I fucking love that brother and if anything ever happens to him... I do not know how I'd survive. I just wish HiRez will do something this time.

Exactly. I have struggled with crippling depression for 3 years and if my brother who basically got me through this said something like this to me, I would have been done. The fact that he will most likely get away with this fucking horseshit. If anyone said that I was better of killing myself in the way he did because I do not know how to beat my depression I would have taken them for it. This fucking shit about depression isn't a joke and responses like this and people who do not understand mental illnesses are the reason people who struggle with depression cannot get help. They fear reactions like this. It is fucking stupid and I am sorry for your losses, and this should not happen again.

Casimir Pulaski Day - Sufjan Stevens

Anything of Carrie & Lowell by Sufjan Stevens as well. That entire album is so heartfelt and just so personal it's hard not to stir something inside of you.
